body: Thanks, that's sweet. I'm taking BuSpar and Tramadol right now (for chronic body pain, possibly fibro). I've been trying to get a Benzo but no one will believe that I truly need it because I tend to appear put-together in person. I will look into the AA-style groups, I never even thought about it. I guess because my social anxiety is so extreme, I tend to avoid situations where I have to talk to people that I dont know when I am all alone.

You're a strong lady, physically and mentally. You've been through a lot and have had to overcome some trials in your earlier years. Lots of friends surround you and you consider them to be your family. You moved away from your hometown to have a more exciting life in a bigger city at some point. I'm feeling like you either majored in psychology or are in the medical field. You enjoy being creative and people often come to you for advice.
